sar.narrative: This Suspicious Activity Report documents unauthorized financial transactions identified on account C13487 associated with payment card C13487-K1. On 2016-11-22, transaction 3478561 was initiated through the online channel under suspicious parameters matching the card not present new device typology. Total unauthorized exposure across the incident is $74.96 USD. Graph expansion identified connectivity to associated card(s) C08771-K1, C02194-K2, C09112-K1 via shared device profile DEV-889104b. Institutional investigation determined the activity was inconsistent with the cardholder's established transactional and regional baseline. In accordance with bank fraud policy, the card was blocked and scheduled for reissue, associated accounts were placed under elevated monitoring, and the transaction was declined to prevent further loss. This filing is submitted pursuant to FinCEN suspicious activity reporting mandates regarding cyber-enabled payment fraud.
